purpose: Turn Elementor JSON source evidence into reproducible source, official-import roundtrip, WordPress/Elementor runtime and browser evidence.

caller.qa_handoff: website-qa-checklist for staging/live acceptance beyond this disposable controlled runtime

required_when: new or screenshot-reconstructed Elementor JSON needs a runtime, import or visual claim
existing Elementor JSON changes structure, widgets, settings, responsive behavior, globals, classes or dependencies
the user asks to test, scan, render, preview, screenshot, verify widgets, verify Pro or check import behavior
source-valid JSON is about to be described as runtime-valid, roundtrip-stable or visually correct
optional_when: source-only analysis or planning needs no runtime/import/visual claim
forbidden_when: input contains secrets, credentials, personal data or client-confidential content while this repository is public
exact target compatibility is claimed without target inventory and staging evidence
the task is a production or live-site mutation

before_run: classify editor family, dependencies, target objects and risk with the Elementor skill
write canonical test JSON under templates/
use target/inventory.json only when sanitized for this public repository
readback: require Static and supply-chain audit success
require Official import roundtrip and browser QA success
inspect source audit, runtime inventory, roundtrip report, render manifest, Pro status and screenshots

inputs.target_inventory: target/inventory.json; sanitized only because repository is public
inputs.elementor_pro_version: ELEMENTOR_PRO_VERSION required repository variable whenever the Pro secret is set
inputs.reference_visual: reviewed Playwright snapshots in version control; confidential client references stay outside this public repository

pipeline: validate contracts, version pins, lockfile and dependency audit
run source-level Elementor JSON and regression tests
install pinned Elementor Core and Hello Elementor
optionally install exact pinned Elementor Pro version from Elementor's Composer repository
export registered widget/control, breakpoint and design-system inventory
audit templates against runtime and optional target inventory
import each JSON with Elementor's official Library Import CLI
reopen and save the imported document through Elementor
re-export stored document data and require semantic roundtrip equality except volatile element IDs
render the roundtripped JSON into an isolated Canvas page
run Chromium, Firefox and WebKit responsive/browser-error/network/overflow/keyboard/automated-accessibility checks
compare screenshots against reviewed same-runtime visual baselines
upload evidence artifacts and destroy the runtime

can_support: official Elementor Library import in the pinned disposable runtime
Elementor reopen/save/re-export semantic roundtrip in that runtime
runtime widget/global availability in that runtime
cross-browser responsive screenshot and automated accessibility smoke evidence
does_not_prove: site-specific dynamic data or IDs without target evidence
pixel equality to a reference that has not been supplied and approved

iteration.on_failure: Repair only confirmed source, import, dependency, roundtrip, render or browser defects and rerun.
iteration.formal_final_gate: After the last code/data change require two identical green final rounds before staging/QA handoff.

privacy.rule: Never commit confidential client JSON, unsanitized target inventory, private screenshots, credentials, license keys, personal data or secret URLs.
privacy.secret_handling: ELEMENTOR_PRO_LICENSE_KEY exists only as a GitHub Actions secret; Pro must also have an explicit version pin.
